context.headline: CoinDesk reports on balance sheet concerns at a major crypto exchange.
context.body: A report questions the financial health of one of crypto's largest exchanges. The market is watching closely. SOL has been trading sideways for a week.

context.headline: Withdrawal processing paused. The exchange is under extreme stress.
context.body: Rumors confirmed: the exchange has halted withdrawals. SOL is down over 40% in 48 hours. Liquidity is evaporating.

context.headline: Exchange officially files for bankruptcy. New leadership takes over.
context.body: The collapse is confirmed. SOL is down 70% from its high. Some traders see a potential relief bounce; others call it a dead cat.

context.headline: Large UST redemptions trigger concern about the algorithmic stablecoin.
context.body: Unusually large sell orders hit the UST-USDC pool. The peg is holding, but there are whispers about sustainability. Bitcoin has been trending down for weeks.

context.headline: UST has broken its $1 peg. LUNA down over 90% in 48 hours.
context.body: The algorithmic stablecoin has entered a death spiral. Billions in value are being destroyed. Bitcoin is selling off hard in sympathy.

context.headline: Global equity markets drop sharply. Crypto follows.
context.body: US employment data comes in weaker than expected. Risk assets are selling off globally. Crypto is not immune.

context.headline: Crypto liquidations cascade. SOL down 30% in three days.
context.body: The Yen carry trade unwind is accelerating. Global markets are in freefall. Crypto leverage is being flushed out.

context.headline: Sweeping new tariffs announced. Global equity futures drop sharply.
context.body: Major tariff increases announced on key trading partners. Stock futures are down 4%. Bitcoin is selling off alongside equities.

context.headline: 90-day tariff pause announced. Markets spike.
context.body: A 90-day pause on most tariffs is announced. Equities rip higher. Bitcoin follows. But tensions remain elevated.

context.headline: SOL drops 18% in hours as over-leveraged longs get liquidated.
context.body: A chain of liquidations hits the market. Open interest was at all-time highs. SOL is printing its largest red candle in months.

context.headline: SOL bounces from the flush. Is the selling done?
context.body: Three days after the cascade, SOL is attempting a recovery. Funding rates have reset. The question is whether this is a dead cat or a real reversal.
